title: OTC market maker
summary: Keeps the cross-chain book filled with NADO-for-ETH asks from the node wallet, and completes every swap a taker starts.

identity.how: the operator's node wallet (private/keys.dat) and its ETH payout account (private/eth_deployer.json) — an operator's own job on their own node, never offered to anyone else

post.summary: post the ladder of asks (each secret written to private/ BEFORE its order exists)

effects.spends: fees; the asks themselves lock nothing until filled

watch.summary: the daemon: lock the NADO for each taker, claim their ETH, settle; expire and refund what nobody pays; keep the ladder filled

effects.spends: the node wallet's NADO into swap locks, at most BUDGET_NADO (400) held at once, plus fees; ETH claim gas from the payout account

cancel.summary: take every open ask of the ladder off the book

safety.note: an operator's live daemon (deploy/units/nado-otc-mm.service); every path is pinned by tests/test_the_otc_market_maker_ends_every_path_with_the_money_where_it_belongs.py

verify: Its asks are on /exec/otc/book?market=ETH; each filled one ends settled (the secret public) with its ETH claimed on Ethereum, or expired with its NADO lock refunded — all readable on both chains.
